title: Hush
concept: A study of light struggling through evolving states of suspended particulate and crystalline growth, moving from muffled stillness to violent structural fracture.
style: No people, no figures, no buildings, no landscape, no horizon. No object with a visible outline — no vessel, bowl, panel or plate. The matter fills the frame edge to edge and continues past it.

scenes.still_prompt: Iridescent layers of microscopic calcium carbonate platelets drifting in a thick, viscous fluid.
beats: Extreme macro: pale, milky surfaces sliding past the lens at a crawl.
Close-up: thin ribbons of pearlescent light curling through a heavy, opalescent medium.
Macro: overlapping translucent scales swirling in a slow, silent rotation.
Medium: a dense cloud of shimmering, milky flakes suspended in deep amber light.
Wide: an expanse of swirling, multi-chromatic silt filling the entire field of vision.
scenes.video_prompt: Fine, dust-like particles catch glints of light as they descend through the murk. The material texture stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: A slow, heavy drift of pale particles through a thick, warm liquid.
motion.mid: Gentle, rhythmic undulations of iridescent layers sliding over one another.
motion.high: Turbulent swirling of pearlescent flakes caught in a sudden internal current.

scenes.still_prompt: Sleek, obsidian-black liquid forming sharp, geometric spikes under an invisible magnetic force.
beats: Macro: a single, glossy black spike rising vertically from a dark plane.
Close-up: a forest of sharp, needle-like protrusions vibrating rapidly.
Medium: a chaotic landscape of obsidian spikes surging and receding in rhythmic pulses.
Wide: a violent, undulating field of black spikes colliding and merging.
Extreme wide: a frenetic, jagged sea of liquid geometry churning in total darkness.
scenes.video_prompt: Tiny, microscopic beads of black oil skittering across a dark surface. The material texture stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: A slow, viscous thickening of dark liquid surfaces.
motion.mid: The rhythmic rising and falling of sharp, oily columns.
motion.high: Violent, jagged spikes erupting and collapsing in rapid succession.

scenes.still_prompt: Brittle, crystalline structures undergoing rapid thermal stress and internal fracturing.
beats: Macro: a single, translucent ice grain expanding as a white crack forms inside.
Close-up: a web of frost-white fractures racing through a clear, frozen mass.
Medium: large sheets of crystalline structure splintering into thousands of jagged shards.
Wide: an explosive network of white fissures tearing through a dense, frozen void.
Extreme wide: a chaotic, blinding spray of crystalline shards rushing toward the lens.
scenes.video_prompt: Microscopic shards of ice glittering in the light as they settle. The material texture stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: The slow, creeping growth of white frost along internal planes.
motion.mid: A steady, rhythmic spider-webbing of cracks through a transparent mass.
motion.high: Violent, explosive shattering of crystalline structures into flying fragments.
